ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Judge the stage of motion from the wording of the stem: the cabin begins to fall freely from 76 m above the ground, and the braking system does not begin to activate until it falls to 28 m above the ground. The question asks about the situation when the cabin falls to 40 m above the ground; because 40 m is higher than 28 m, the cabin is still in the free-fall stage at this time. Analyze the forces on the beverage bottle in the ground inertial frame: the beverage bottle is subject to gravity mg downward, and the support force N of the hand on the bottle upward; the beverage bottle moves together with the cabin with acceleration g downward. Taking downward as positive, from Newton's second law, mg - N = ma = mg, therefore N = 0. The force exerted by the beverage bottle on the hand and the support force exerted by the hand on the bottle are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction, so the force exerted by the beverage bottle on the hand is 0.
